title: parseCreatures: Goblin loses (goblinoid) subtype and description on real SRD PDF
description:
With loreweaver-9bu landing, verify:dnd5e-srd-pack now runs end-to-end and surfaces a parseCreatures regression on the real SRD 5.1 PDF:

  creature:goblin:
    data.description: "Goblins are small, black-hearted humanoids that lair in despoiled dungeons and other dismal settings." → <missing>
    data.type: "humanoid (goblinoid)" → "humanoid"
    provenance.locator: "p. 138" → "p. 315"
    source: "SRD 5.1 p. 138" → "SRD 5.1 p. 315"

Reproduce: npm run verify:dnd5e-srd-pack on a tree with loreweaver-9bu merged.

Investigation pointers:
- p. 315 is the correct location of the Goblin stat block in the real SRD 5.1 PDF (verified by extraction). The committed pack's "p. 138" likely reflects an older / different SRD source where the Goblin had additional flavor prose; the committed description ("black-hearted humanoids that lair in despoiled dungeons...") is also not present at p. 315 in SRD 5.1, so the <missing> description may actually be correct for this PDF — verify before assuming it's a parser bug.
- The type collapse "humanoid (goblinoid)" → "humanoid" IS a parser bug: the parenthesized race/subtype qualifier on the size-and-type line ("Small humanoid (goblinoid), neutral evil") is being stripped. parseCreatures probably extracts only the leading kind word and drops the "(goblinoid)" tag on the real-PDF layout.
- The PDF extraction at p. 315 confirms the line is "Small humanoid (goblinoid), neutral evil" — clean text, no column-wrap quirk.
- See packages/core/scripts/importers/dnd5e-srd-5.1/parseCreatures.ts and existing fixture tests for how the type line is parsed.
- Scope this bead to just the type-qualifier fix; if the description difference turns out to need attention, file a separate bead.
close_reason: Fixed in branch fix/srd-spell-class-columns-creature-subtype: extract wide-gutter hatch separates single-x spell-list columns (xbh); parseCreatures preserves parenthetical subtype (2ze). Verified against real SRD PDF; full suite green.
